title: nf-proteindesign pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow pipeline for Boltzgen protein design using pre-made design YAML specifications

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.help_text:
The samplesheet must contain: `sample_id`, `design_yaml`, `target_sequence`, and optionally: `structure_files`, `protocol`, `num_designs`, `budget`, `reuse`, `target_msa`, `target_template`

See schema file in assets/schema_input_design.json for detailed specifications.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved.

design_tool_options.title: Backbone design tool
design_tool_options.description: Select the generative model used for protein backbone design.

design_tool.description: Generative backbone design tool to use.
design_tool.help_text:
Select which tool performs the backbone design step:
- **boltzgen** (default): Boltzgen diffusion model (Seqera container).
- **proteina_complexa**: Proteina-Complexa — NVIDIA flow-based generative model; co-designs sequence and structure simultaneously (ICLR 2026).

All downstream steps (ProteinMPNN, Boltz-2, analysis) are unaffected by this choice.

boltzgen_options.title: Boltzgen design parameters
boltzgen_options.description: Core parameters for Boltzgen protein design execution.

cache_dir.help_text: If not specified, defaults to ~/.cache. The cache directory stores downloaded model weights for faster execution.

boltzgen_config.description: Optional path to custom Boltzgen config YAML to override defaults.

steps.description: Optional comma-separated list of steps to run (e.g., 'filtering' to rerun only filtering).
steps.help_text: Advanced option for rerunning specific Boltzgen pipeline steps.

proteinmpnn_options.title: ProteinMPNN sequence optimization
proteinmpnn_options.description: Options for ProteinMPNN sequence optimization of designed structures.

run_proteinmpnn.description: Enable ProteinMPNN sequence optimization of Boltzgen designs.
run_proteinmpnn.help_text: ProteinMPNN can further optimize sequences for the designed structures.

mpnn_sampling_temp.help_text: Recommended range: 0.1-0.3. Lower values produce more conservative sequences.

mpnn_num_seq_per_target.description: Number of sequence variants to generate per structure.

mpnn_backbone_noise.description: Backbone noise level (lower = more faithful to input).

mpnn_save_probs.description: Save per-residue probabilities (large files, use for detailed analysis).

mpnn_fixed_chains.description: Chains to keep fixed (e.g., 'A,B' - typically the target chains).

mpnn_designed_chains.description: Chains to design (e.g., 'C' - typically the binder chain).

boltz2_options.title: Boltz-2 structure prediction
boltz2_options.description: Options for Boltz-2 multimer structure prediction of ProteinMPNN sequences.

run_boltz2_refold.description: Enable Boltz-2 structure prediction for ProteinMPNN sequences.
run_boltz2_refold.help_text: Boltz-2 predicts multimer structures combining ProteinMPNN-designed binders with target proteins. Requires run_proteinmpnn to be enabled.

boltz2_num_diffusion.description: Number of diffusion samples per sequence (higher = more diversity).
boltz2_num_diffusion.help_text: Multiple samples can capture structural diversity but increase computation time.

boltz2_num_recycling.description: Number of recycling iterations for structure refinement.
boltz2_num_recycling.help_text: More recycling steps improve accuracy but increase computation time.

boltz2_use_msa.description: Use multiple sequence alignments (MSAs) for prediction.
boltz2_use_msa.help_text: MSAs can improve accuracy but significantly increase runtime and memory requirements.

boltz2_predict_affinity.description: Predict binding affinity for protein complexes.
boltz2_predict_affinity.help_text: Enables ipSAE calculation using native Boltz-2 confidence scores.

analysis_options.title: Analysis and scoring options
analysis_options.description: Options for scoring and evaluating designed structures.

run_ipsae.description: Enable IPSAE scoring of Boltzgen predictions.
run_ipsae.help_text: IPSAE evaluates protein-protein interface quality using predicted aligned error (PAE) and structural distances.

run_prodigy.description: Enable PRODIGY binding affinity prediction on final designs.
run_prodigy.help_text: PRODIGY predicts binding free energy (ΔG) based on interface properties.

prodigy_selection.description: Chain selection for PRODIGY (e.g., 'A,B'). If null, auto-detects from structure.

run_foldseek.description: Enable Foldseek structural similarity search for budget designs and Boltz-2 structures.
run_foldseek.help_text: Foldseek searches for structurally similar proteins in databases (e.g., AlphaFold, Swiss-Model) to identify related structures. Runs in parallel with ipSAE and PRODIGY. GPU-accelerated for 4-27x speedup.

foldseek_database.description: Path to Foldseek database directory (required if run_foldseek is true).
foldseek_database.help_text: Path to directory containing Foldseek database files. Common databases include AlphaFold, Swiss-Model, PDB, or custom databases created with 'foldseek createdb'. Use AlphaFold/UniProt50 for comprehensive structural searches.

foldseek_database_name.description: Name of the Foldseek database within the directory.
foldseek_database_name.help_text: The database name (without extension) to use within the foldseek_database directory. Common values: 'afdb' (AlphaFold), 'swissprot' (Swiss-Prot), 'pdb' (Protein Data Bank), or your custom database name.

foldseek_evalue.description: E-value threshold for reporting matches (lower = more stringent).

foldseek_max_seqs.description: Maximum number of target sequences to report per query.

foldseek_sensitivity.description: Search sensitivity (1.0-9.5, higher = more sensitive but slower).

foldseek_coverage.description: Minimum fraction of aligned residues (0.0-1.0, higher = more global alignment).

run_consolidation.help_text: Generates a comprehensive report combining Boltzgen, ProteinMPNN, IPSAE, and PRODIGY results.

report_top_n.description: Number of top designs to highlight in consolidated report.

resource_options.title: Resource allocation
resource_options.description: Maximum resource limits for pipeline execution.

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs per process.

max_gpus.description: Maximum number of GPUs per process.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text: These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customize things like pipeline name, tracedir, etc.

publish_dir_mode.help_text:
Determines how output files are published:
- **copy**: Copy files to output directory
- **symlink**: Create symbolic links
- **move**: Move files (use with caution)

tracedir.description: Directory to store pipeline execution traces.

validate_params.description: Validate parameters against the schema at runtime.

show_hidden_params.description: Show hidden parameters in help message.
